tools.name: chrome_health
tools.title: Chrome Health
tools.description: Report local Chrome, profile, adapter, and bridge readiness without attaching to a live tab.

tools.name: chrome_targets
tools.title: Chrome Targets
tools.description: List safe previews for candidate Chrome tabs and windows using bounded title, origin, path, profile label, recency, and match reason.

tools.name: tab_snapshot
tools.title: Tab Snapshot
tools.description: Create a fixture or dry-run snapshot request for a selected tab surface.

tools.name: debug_bundle_create
tools.title: Create Debug Bundle
tools.description: Create a bounded debug bundle from fixture or dry-run evidence sources.

tools.name: debug_bundle_read
tools.title: Read Debug Bundle
tools.description: Read bundle metadata, timeline, summaries, or safe evidence slices from an existing debug bundle.

tools.name: debug_bundle_redact
tools.title: Redact Debug Bundle
tools.description: Apply the plugin redaction policy to an existing debug bundle and return redaction counts.

tools.name: api_calls_collect
tools.title: Collect API Calls
tools.description: Collect or replay a bounded API call inventory with optional redacted cURL previews.

tools.name: api_call_to_curl
tools.title: API Call To cURL
tools.description: Convert one captured API call into a redacted cURL command that omits cookies, bearer tokens, API keys, CSRF tokens, session headers, and secret query parameters.

tools.name: api_response_read
tools.title: Read API Response
tools.description: Read safe response metadata and bounded redacted fixture bodies when explicitly permitted.

tools.name: debug_run_compare
tools.title: Compare Debug Runs
tools.description: Compare two debug-run fixtures and summarize API, console, screenshot, timeline, and fingerprint differences.

tools.name: context7_doctor
tools.title: Context7 Doctor
tools.description: Check Context7 availability and docs/schema drift gates needed by this plugin slice.

tools.name: upstream_mcp_doctor
tools.title: Upstream MCP Doctor
tools.description: Report official Chrome DevTools MCP version, category, connection-mode, and safety-flag readiness.

tools.name: take_heapsnapshot
tools.title: Capture Heap Snapshot
tools.description: Capture a heap snapshot through the local gated memory route.

tools.name: get_heapsnapshot_summary
tools.title: Heap Snapshot Summary
tools.description: Read summary statistics from a locally scoped heap snapshot.

tools.name: get_heapsnapshot_details
tools.title: Heap Snapshot Details
tools.description: Read paginated heap aggregates with optional retention filters.

tools.name: get_heapsnapshot_class_nodes
tools.title: Heap Class Nodes
tools.description: Read paginated instances of one heap class.

tools.name: get_heapsnapshot_retainers
tools.title: Heap Retainers
tools.description: Read bounded retainers for one heap node.

tools.name: close_heapsnapshot
tools.title: Close Heap Snapshot

tools.name: get_heapsnapshot_retaining_paths
tools.title: Heap Retaining Paths

tools.name: get_heapsnapshot_edges

tools.name: get_heapsnapshot_dominators
tools.title: Heap Dominators

tools.name: compare_heapsnapshots

tools.name: get_heapsnapshot_duplicate_strings
tools.title: Heap Duplicate Strings
tools.description: Find duplicate heap strings with original values redacted and SHA-256 hashed.
